bio: Drawing from her experience at a top New York restaurant, Chef Hyeon-ju Lim develops a creative approach to Nu-American French cuisine. Known for her bold ingredient choices and keen sense of composition, Chef Lim delivers dishes that highlight the character of each element. The signature Truffle features a crisp shell filled with fermented mushroom and truffle cream—rich and refined. The meal concludes with a distinctive chocolate foam, offering a memorable finish....
